title: Site config v1
description: One site's product page parsing rules. A site file may extend a template from configs/templates/; objects are merged deeply and the site's arrays replace the template's. The service checks the merged result with the same rules (internal/siteconfig/loader.go), plus selector and regular expression compilation.

engine.description: Fetch strategy: http fetches with Colly over Go's HTTP client; browser loads the page in real Chrome through Playwright (needs APP_BROWSER_ENABLED on the instance); duckduckgo and brave never contact the site and build the product from search results (need APP_DUCKDUCKGO_ENABLED, or APP_BRAVE_ENABLED and a Brave API key).

alternate_engines.description: Search engines used, in order, when engine is not enabled on the instance. Chosen once per request; a failed fetch is never retried on another engine. Only allowed when engine is a search engine.

search.description: Search settings. Only allowed when engine is duckduckgo or brave.

region.description: <country>-<lang>, for example us-en or de-de; wt-wt means no region.

title_strip.description: Suffixes and prefixes removed from the result title, for example " | Ferguson Home".

ignore_params.description: Extra query parameters ignored when matching result URLs to the requested URL, for example uid.

queries.description: Queries to try, in order: site_slug = site:<domain> <words from the URL path>; url = the product URL in quotes.

user_agents.description: Replaces user_agent when set: each fetch picks one at random and keeps it for its retries and redirects.

price_unit.description: toman and rial sites return toman (currency IRT; rial is divided by 10). usd and eur sites return cents (currency USD or EUR).

items.description: Go regular expression on the URL path

root.description: CSS selector of the element that contains the product

price_area.description: CSS selector whose text is returned as price.raw and checked for call_for_price_words

specs.description: Optional name/value pairs returned as product.specs. Each selector is searched inside the previous one: group in root, title and row in group, name and value in row. In the siblings layout there is no row: name is searched in the group and its value is the following siblings up to the next name. Missing specs never fail a request.

layout.description: rows: each row holds a name and a value. siblings: name and value elements are siblings with no row, like dt/dd or h3/p

group.description: Elements that each hold one titled group of rows. Empty means the root is one untitled group

title.description: Group heading inside group. Needs group

value.description: In the siblings layout, optional: only following siblings matching it are part of the value

separator.description: Read every element matching value and join their texts with it, for example ", " for a list of li. Without it a row's value is the first match (siblings: joined with a space)

exclude.description: Elements inside title, name, or value whose text is left out, for example a hidden tooltip

attr.description: Attributes tried in order; without attr the element text is used
